mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm glad you're here. Have you ever wondered what really tips the scales in a conversation, even before the first word is spoken? Imagine if the outcome of a decision was already being shaped—quietly and invisibly—just by where your attention falls, or the mood of the room. That’s the fascinating world we’re about to explore together, inspired by Robert B. Cialdini’s eye-opening book, Pre-Suasion: A Revolutionary Way to Influence and Persuade. We’re going beyond the arguments themselves, diving into those subtle moments right before a request is made—when context, environment, and even a fleeting thought can set the stage for what’s to come. We’ll unpack the science behind how tiny shifts in focus and framing can dramatically shape what people are willing to accept—or even notice. From surprising research findings to real-world stories, you'll see how attention and intention work hand-in-hand, often influencing us before we’re even aware of it. So, if you’re curious about how influence really works—and want to discover practical ways to use these insights in your own life—let’s take this journey together. Get ready to uncover the hidden forces that set the stage for every decision and conversation.
